clips.text: Your mouth makes a liter of medicine a day — and you spit it out.
He cut his palm — bleeding, no first-aid kit. So he did what we all do. He put it to his mouth.
Bite the inside of your cheek. Gone in days — while a cut on your arm takes weeks, and leaves a scar.
Your mouth heals wounds five to ten times faster than your skin.
The cheek heals in days, the arm takes weeks. Something in your mouth is doing the work.
How much medicine does your mouth make every single day?
Your spit carries a wound-closing protein and a painkiller stronger than morphine — and a hundred million bacteria in every drop.
